_note: Schema-correct skeletons for two new NPC entries, matching the shape used throughout the existing NPCS data (verified against odell, assistant, and ropewalk_foreman). This is the TARGET JSON shape the dialogue compiler needs to produce — since 'source' points at a .dialogue script (dialogue_lang.gd/dialogue_runtime.gd compile those into this JSON), whoever authors the actual content will likely write it in that DSL, not hand-edit this JSON. Use this as the checklist for what the compiled output must contain, and delete this _note key before merging either block into NPCS.

_new_locations_needed._note: Add these two entries to the LOCATIONS object (plain JS object literal, unquoted keys like the existing ones) before either NPC below will render anywhere sensible in the tool.

steps.speaker: CAPTAIN ODELL
steps.text: PLACEHOLDER — first line Odell says when Walter finds him at the precinct. Replace before ship.

steps.speaker: CAPTAIN ODELL
steps.text: PLACEHOLDER — what Odell says on a repeat visit, before he's given the substantive topic below. Delete this stub once real repeat lines exist, or fold it into 'default' if a repeat line isn't needed.

topics.gate_src: NOT topic_done(odell, default) AND NOT topic_done(odell_precinct, PLACEHOLDER_TOPIC_ID) — EXAMPLE ONLY, this AND branch is almost certainly backwards for what you want (see note below)
topics.label: PLACEHOLDER — ask Odell about something raised at the estate

steps.speaker: WALTER CORWIN
steps.text: PLACEHOLDER — player line referencing something Odell already said or refused at the estate.

steps.speaker: CAPTAIN ODELL

topics.gate_src: evidence(some_evidence_found_at_estate) AND NOT topic_done(assistant_morgue, PLACEHOLDER_TOPIC_ID) — this is the pattern ropewalk_foreman's cellar_salt topic uses: gate a follow-up on evidence gathered elsewhere, guard against repeating once seen
topics.label: PLACEHOLDER — ask about the wounds/bodies using estate evidence as the key

steps.speaker: WALTER CORWIN
steps.text: PLACEHOLDER — player references specific evidence from the estate scene.

_gating_reminders: topic_done(npc_id, topic_id) and evidence(evidence_id) both take an explicit id — they are NOT scoped to 'self', so odell_precinct topics can freely reference topic_done(odell, ...) or evidence(...) discovered back at the estate, and vice versa. That's the whole mechanism for making 'estate Odell' and 'precinct Odell' read as one continuous character rather than two strangers.
Evidence ids are global across the whole NPCS object (confirmed by walking every gate_src reference against every evidence-kind step in the file) — no namespacing needed there, unlike topic_done.

The AND-branch in the odell_precinct example topic above is written speculatively (NOT topic_done(odell, default) AND NOT topic_done(odell_precinct, this-topic)) — that reads as 'only offer this if Walter has NOT yet talked to estate-Odell', which is probably backwards (you likely want him to HAVE talked to estate Odell first — i.e. a plain evidence(...)/topic_done(odell, ...) check WITHOUT the 'not', same shape as ropewalk_foreman's gates). Left it visibly wrong on purpose as a flag, not a real recommendation — fix the boolean before using it.

None of this controls whether 'precinct' or 'morgue' are reachable locations at a given point in the story — that's the Godot travel/world-state code's job (chapter_one.gd's _travel/state.world/state.visited), separate from this NPCS data and not something this JSON can express.

visit_count(npc_id) is also per-NPC-id, same as topic_done — odell_precinct starts at 0 regardless of how many times Walter visited estate-Odell, which is almost certainly the correct behavior for a new scene/location.
